To handle a prospect asking for immediate deletion, Teams availability, and custom pricing, a sales representative should follow these verified procedures:

**Immediate deletion:** Do not promise immediate data deletion or sign a custom SLA without first consulting Priya Raman (Security and Governance Lead) [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. The standard corporate policy requires data deletion within 90 days of contract termination [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. While data is removed from active user access immediately upon termination, physical deletion from primary storage and backups takes up to 90 days [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. For Enterprise clients, a custom SLA exception can be negotiated in the DPA, allowing a 30-day purge of active records and a 60-day purge of backup archives (deleting backups faster than 60 days is technically impossible) [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. This exception must be formally documented in the legal DPA and cannot rely on verbal or informal sales commitments [NL-019#NL-019-S05].

**Teams availability:** The rep must consult Sofia Almeida (VP Product) or the official Product Roadmap (NL-014) and must not guarantee a specific launch date [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. The roadmap places the Microsoft Teams integration in the planning and design phase for Q4 2026, and dates must be framed as targets, not contractual guarantees [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. The company explicitly refuses to release insecure "alpha" builds or one-off custom integrates for clients due to multi-tenant infrastructure and QA constraints [NL-027#NL-027-S04]. Instead, the rep should pivot to selling citation reliability and strict data isolation (e.g., guaranteeing 85% citation correctness) and suggest the responsive mobile web interface as a workaround [NL-027#NL-027-S04].

**Custom pricing:** Do not offer custom discounts on the Starter or Growth plans [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Any discounts must be approved by Marcus Reed (VP Sales) and must align with the current pricing sheet (NL-003) [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Historical prices (e.g., the deprecate $900/month Starter plan from the 2025 proposal) must never be used in active proposals [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Enterprise plan pricing starts at $8,500/month with a minimum $15,000 onboarding fee, but is subject to security review, seat count, and integration requirements, and final enterprise pricing cannot be quoted on discovery calls [NL-009#NL-009-S08] [NL-004#NL-004-S05].
